newsitem.title: USA: Entergy La. Waterford nuke cutting to 60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Entergy La. Waterford nuke cutting to 60 pct.

text.p: Entergy Corp's 1,075 megawatt Waterford 3 nuclear power plant in Taft, La., operating at 70 percent power early Thursday, is expected to reduce further to 60 percent, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said in its morning report.
The power reduction is needed to change the bearings on a main feedwater pump, the NRC report stated.
The company was not immediately available for comment and no estimated duration for the reduction was given by the NRC.
